name: Giving up a slot leaves no derived view still claiming it

statusDetails.message: Request: POST /api/standing-slots/give-up {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"} after that standing slot was confirmed. Observed: HTTP 200 {"ok":true}. Re-read: posted list {"slots":[]}; heater schedule {"entries":[]}; schedule shows Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 free with holder null. Invoicing signals still contain standing_slot_charge inv-1 for apartment 12, pukuhuone 8, Tuesday 17:00–18:30 and also standing_slot_cancelled inv-2 for apartment 12 at that slot. Consequence: the list and heater no longer claim the slot, but a standing-slot charge for apartment 12 remains, so the billing view disagrees with the other derived views.

labels.name: story
labels.value: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing
